mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.author_id, a.status, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.publish_time, a.create_time, a.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT , c.name as category_name, u.nickname as author_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article (title, summary, content, cover_image, category_id, author_id, status, view_count, like_count, publish_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{coverImage}, #{categoryId}, #{authorId}, #{status}, 0, 0, #{publishTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT , c.name as category_name, u.nickname as author_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.category_id = #{categoryId} AND a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC

SELECT , c.name as category_name, u.nickname as author_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
